listing.name: WipEout / Alexbeav PSXRecomp
listing.summary: Play WipEout with a player built from your matching original PlayStation disc and BIOS.

steps.title: Supply your matching disc and BIOS
steps.instruction: Use the original European WipEout disc (SCES-00010) with all 12 tracks. This kit requires your own retail SCPH-5552 BIOS dump. Keep the CUE and every referenced track together when using CUE/BIN.

steps.title: Prepare the managed Windows or Linux player
steps.instruction: In Portcove, select the complete matching CHD and your SCPH-5552 BIOS. On Linux, use a native C/C++ compiler, CMake, Ninja and Python 3.10 or newer. Choose Play after Portcove builds the player.

steps.title: Prepare a separate Mac player
steps.instruction: Choose the official v0.1.4 ZIP for your Intel or Apple silicon Mac and unpack it into a writable folder. Put Xcode Command Line Tools, CMake, Ninja and Python 3.10 or newer on PATH. The bundled game and BIOS generators require macOS 15 or newer.

steps.title: Build and add the player on Mac
steps.instruction: Run WipEout_Recompiled from the unpacked folder and choose Generate & rebuild. In Portcove, select build-release/WipEout_Recompiled as the program and build-release as its start folder.

warnings: The managed route checks the original European release. The European Rev 1 disc has a different identity.
Portcove checks the first data track and track count. Keep the entire original disc intact.
The kit records BIOS-stage audio and FMV placement defects. Portcove has not verified native setup or gameplay.

references.title: Updates and backups
references.instruction: Keep the complete working folder and back up your disc image, BIOS, saves, settings and overlay captures before replacing the kit. Keep the player with the folder that built it.

references.title: Linux generator compatibility
references.instruction: The bundled Linux generators require glibc 2.14 or newer and libstdc++ with GLIBCXX_3.4.26.

presentation.manual_preparation: Use the original European WipEout disc (SCES-00010) with all 12 tracks. Select the complete CHD and your retail SCPH-5552 BIOS in Portcove. On Linux, use native C/C++ tools, CMake, Ninja and Python 3.10 or newer. Choose Play after Portcove builds the player.
